lines.text: It’s project time! Today you will write, illustrate and design your very own AI storybook.
In this project, you make the big decisions: the hero, the place and the problem.
AI suggests ideas and helps you polish, but the story is yours.
Every good story needs a character, a setting, a problem and an ending.
Ask AI for three ideas for each, then choose or mix your favourites.
Write an image prompt for each page with the same character description every time.
That keeps your hero looking the same on every page.
On the last page of your book, write what you did and what AI did.
For example: the story is by Riya, the ideas were helped by AI, and the pictures were made with AI.
The learner gives the AI a role, the hero, the setting, and a clear limit.
The AI suggests ideas but does not write the story — the author chooses.
Watch closely: the AI replaced Tara’s talking cricket bat with a dog called Bolt.
AI can forget details or invent new ones, so the author reads every line it changes.
Now open Canva and choose a storybook or presentation template.
Add the cover, four story pages and a credits page.
Place your pictures and story text, then download it as a PDF to show your family.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
